entries.label: Biome id
entries.description: Unique biome identifier (Biome.X). ROW ORDER IS SIGNIFICANT: row order is the runtime biome index and the classification tie-break (lowest index wins). Reordering rows changes generated worlds; appending a row changes none.

entries.label: Tags
entries.description: List of tags drawn from this vocabulary.

values.label: water
values.description: Aquatic-only cells that land species cannot enter (Ocean, Lake).

values.label: aquatic
values.description: Aquatic species can live here (water biomes, and Wetland).

values.label: fuel
values.description: This biome has a fire-succession rule to BurnedAshland (Grassland, TemperateForest, Scrub). Does not gate ignition or spread: land plus biomass answers that.

values.label: mountain
values.description: High mountain terrain; distinct from volcanic.

values.label: volcanic
values.description: Land shaped by a vent; distinct from mountain.

values.label: succession
values.description: Not placed by the generator; produced by ecology succession.

entries.label: Generated
entries.description: True when the generator may place this biome; false for succession biomes.

entries.label: Zones
entries.description: List of DepthZone ids where the biome is valid; empty means no zone admits it.

entries.label: Roles
entries.description: List of structural roles this row holds. Each role is held by exactly one row.

values.label: fallback
values.description: Biome used for an unknown id.

entries.label: Climate temperature centre
entries.description: Temperature centre of the climate envelope. Rows with a climate block compete in the climate score, in row order.

entries.label: Climate moisture centre
entries.description: Moisture centre of the climate envelope.

entries.label: Climate temperature width
entries.description: Temperature width of the climate envelope; must be greater than 0.

entries.label: Climate moisture width
entries.description: Moisture width of the climate envelope; must be greater than 0.

entries.label: Pin rule
entries.description: Terrain test that pins cells to this biome before climate scoring.

values.label: vent
values.description: Volcanic vent cells and volcanic barrier chains.

values.label: alpine
values.description: Mountain, peak, cliff and pass terrain.

entries.label: Pin priority
entries.description: Pin precedence; higher is tested first. Must be distinct across rows.

entries.label: Plateau climate
entries.description: Plateau interior biome: wet or dry by mean moisture. At most one row per value.

entries.label: Forbidden pairs
entries.description: Flat list of biome ids; consecutive entries form unordered forbidden neighbour pairs ([a,b] pairs in the file).
